1937, September
FATHER SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 215 Cont.
Sep. 29 Aloysius Sauter - 19 - ... specialists at sea as to what real trouble might be.
Mary Sanstor - 38 - looking for work Mrs. Eliz. John Altwies - 64 - colitis ... Mrs. Sadie Seaman - elderly "pastor scientest - arthritis. .. two of them - Enrolled in S.M.As.
Page 216 Sep. 29 Arthur Fleson - 47 - atheist - wife Cr. scientist - away from wife 11 weeks - Wife promises to read "the Conception of Mary" by Sister Mary of Jesus (Agreda) if husband changes attitude before week is over.
Mrs. Geraldine Crain - 30 - very sick-heart-kidney-etc. - has two small children.
Wm. C. Clapp - 51 - badly infected neck-glands. Non Cath. Wife & children raised Catholic ......
Mrs. Anna Sawnvsch - 62 - Evangelist - intestinal trouble and burn- ing all over body.
Gowenlock girl - 21 - blind ... can now see even .... astonishing. .
Page 217 Sep. 30 Audrey Tank - 19 - in Ford Hosp. - had operation first when 18 months old - 2nd at 42, and finally Sept. 21 last for "cleft palete Now doctors think "only a miracle will cure her. Her brother and Father here To-night promise to read the "Conception" of Mary Immaculate if Drs. be surprised to-morrow.
1937, October
October Oct. Ist Her Pastor, Fr. Brokaw, brought Fr. Sol over To-day and patient A.T. said delighted ... assures ... "Dr. was surprised.
Francis Berthiaume of Bay City - 19 - operated on for apendicitis 16 yrs ago ... draining ever since .... Mother promises to read "City of God 1 - if further operation be avoided.
Oct. 5th Mrs. Josephine Kenny - 42 - Operated last Oct. - cancer of breast removing left breast. August 25 Dr's found simptoms. To-day she takes the "Coronation" City of God promising if outlook brightened she'll read all four.
